Tengwar Telcontar 0.08 -- original font files
=============================================

tengtelc.ttf   Tengwar Telcontar Regular
tengtelcb.ttf  Tengwar Telcontar Bold

Unmodified TTFs from the upstream release archive TengwarTelcontar.008.zip
(https://freetengwar.sourceforge.net/tengtelc.html), Copyright (C) 2005-2009
Johan Winge, part of the Free Tengwar Font Project.

Licence: GPL-3.0-or-later WITH Font-exception-2.0. The upstream licence
notice, the font exception and the full GPL-3.0 text are in
wiki/assets/fonts/COPYING-TengwarTelcontar.txt.

These files are the Corresponding Source of wiki/assets/fonts/TengwarTelcontar.woff2
and TengwarTelcontar-Bold.woff2, which are lossless WOFF2 conversions of them.
They are kept here, outside the served /assets path, and are not part of the
Docker image.
